title: API 密钥泄露事件响应

sources.title: CircleCI Jan-4-2023 Security Incident Report (Official Post-Mortem)
sources.key_facts: Data exfiltration date: 2022-12-22; customer-detected anomaly date: 2022-12-29; GitHub OAuth token rotation completed: 2023-01-07T07:30:00Z; malware artifact SHA256: 8913e38592228adc067d82f66c150d87004ec946e579d4a00c53b61444ff35bf; fewer than 5 customers reported unauthorized access to third-party systems; attack vector: session cookie theft via malware on engineer laptop; encryption keys extracted from running process

sources.title: Codecov April 2021 Post-Mortem (Official)
sources.key_facts: Detection method: SHA256 checksum mismatch by a customer; disclosure date: 2021-04-15; attack vector: HMAC key extracted from intermediate Docker image layer; affected tools: Bash Uploader, GitHub Action, CircleCI Orb, Bitrise Step; data exfiltrated via curl to attacker-controlled IP

sources.title: GitGuardian State of Secrets Sprawl 2024
sources.key_facts: 12,778,599 new secrets detected in public GitHub commits in 2023 (+28% YoY); 1212x surge in OpenAI API key leaks in 2023; >90% of exposed secrets remained active 5 days post-detection; only 2.6% revoked within 1 hour of notification; 7 out of 1000 commits exposed at least one secret; 28.2% of repositories hosting leaked secrets remained publicly accessible

sources.title: GitHub Secret Scanning REST API Documentation
sources.key_facts: Alert schema fields: number, created_at, updated_at, url, html_url, state, resolution, resolved_at, secret_type, secret_type_display_name, validity, publicly_leaked, push_protection_bypassed; state enum: open|resolved; resolution enum: false_positive|wont_fix|revoked|used_in_tests|pattern_edited|pattern_deleted; validity enum: active|inactive|unknown; PATCH endpoint: /repos/{owner}/{repo}/secret-scanning/alerts/{alert_number}

sources.title: AWS GuardDuty: Remediating Potentially Compromised AWS Credentials
sources.key_facts: Long-term IAM user access keys prefix: AKIA; STS temporary credentials prefix: ASIA; sessionIssuer element in CloudTrail identifies role origin; User Type and User name fields in GuardDuty finding details; GuardDuty finding Resource type: AccessKey

sources.title: AWS Security Blog: What to Do If You Inadvertently Expose an AWS Access Key
sources.key_facts: Temporary credentials via GetSessionToken or GetFederationToken can last up to 36 hours; AssumeRole maximum lifespan: 1 hour; recommend applying deny-all policy with DateLessThan condition on aws:TokenIssueTime; specific API names: GetFederationToken, GetSessionToken, AssumeRole

sources.title: AWS Config Managed Rule: access-keys-rotated
sources.key_facts: Rule identifier: ACCESS_KEYS_ROTATED; parameter: maxAccessKeyAge (type: int, default: 90); resource type: AWS::IAM::User; trigger type: Periodic; NON_COMPLIANT if access keys not rotated within maxAccessKeyAge days

sources.title: GitHub Blog: Next Evolution of GitHub Advanced Security (39M Secrets Leaked in 2024)
sources.key_facts: 39 million secrets leaked across GitHub in 2024; Push Protection achieves 75% precision rate (next best: 46%); GitHub blocks several secrets every minute with push protection; Secret Risk Assessment launched as free point-in-time org-wide scan

sources.title: GitHub Supported Secret Scanning Patterns
sources.key_facts: openai_api_key: push protection=yes, validity checks=yes; anthropic_api_key: push protection=yes, validity checks=yes, base64=yes; anthropic_admin_api_key: push protection=yes, validity checks=yes; aws_access_key_id+aws_secret_access_key: push protection=yes, validity checks=yes, base64=yes; google_cloud_service_account_credentials: push protection=yes

sources.title: OWASP API Security Top 10 2023: API2:2023 Broken Authentication
sources.key_facts: CWE-204: Observable Response Discrepancy; CWE-307: Improper Restriction of Excessive Authentication Attempts; also related CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials; vulnerabilities include accepting JWTs with alg:none, transmitting credentials in URLs

sources.title: GitGuardian: Remediating OpenAI API Key Leaks
sources.key_facts: Remediation steps: review access logs for unauthorized use, generate new API key in OpenAI dashboard, update all services, deactivate old key after verification; recommend keeping inventory of all services using the key

sources.title: TruffleHog GitHub Repository (trufflesecurity/trufflehog)
sources.key_facts: Over 800 secret type detectors; result states: Verified/Unverified/Unknown; --fail flag exits with code 183 if credentials found; --json flag for JSON output; --results flag to filter by state; supports git, S3, GCS, Slack, Jira, CircleCI, Docker images, and more; DetectorName is a real output field
